newsitem.title: USA: St. Joseph Light Q1 net hurt by weather.
newsitem.headline: St. Joseph Light Q1 net hurt by weather.

text.p: St. Joseph Light & Power Co said Monday warmer-than-normal temperatures slightly reduced its earnings and revenues in the first quarter ended March 31.

The utility reported net income of $2.0 million, or $0.25 a share, compared to $2.1 million, or $0.27, in the same period a year ago. Operating revenues slipped to $23.5 million from $23.6 million last year, the company said.
St. Joseph said warmer winter weather reduced both electric and gas sales compared to 1996, when temperatures were lower than normal.
St. Joseph provides electricity and natural gas services.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 15-3/4.
